title: The Lighthouse Year
author: You
description: The skeleton of a long book: chapters, page titles shown to the reader, notes to yourself, achievements, a journal and undo.

log.title: The last keeper's log
log.text: "Oil the gears on the first of the month. Trust the lamp, not the weather. If the bell rings by itself, do not go down to look."

keeper.title: Keeper
keeper.description: Signed on for a second year.

stormwatch.title: Stormwatch
stormwatch.description: Kept the lamp lit through the great storm.

landing.title: The landing
landing.note: Opening page. Keep it short: the reader wants to get inside.
landing.text: The supply boat leaves you on the rock with a sea chest and a year's contract. Above you the lighthouse stands white against a slate sky.

choices.text: Climb straight to the lamp room
Look round the keeper's quarters first

quarters.title: The keeper's quarters
quarters.note: Optional page: gives the journal entry. A reader who skips it loses nothing they need.
quarters.text: A bunk, a stove, a shelf of tide tables. In the desk you find the last keeper's log, its final page torn out.

lamp.title: The lamp room
lamp.note: End of part one. Everything before this is setup.
lamp.text: Brass, glass and a clockwork as tall as you are. You wind it, trim the wick and, as the light goes, set the great lamp turning for the first time.

storm.title: The great storm
storm.note: The one hard choice of the book. Undo is on (rules.undo), so a reader can come back and try the other way.
storm.text: In the dead of winter a storm comes out of the north that shakes the tower like a rattle. Near midnight the clockwork jams. Out in the dark, a ship's horn sounds.

choices.text: Turn the lamp by hand all night (Test your Luck)
It cannot be done. Go below and wait it out

dawn.title: Dawn
dawn.text: Your arms are lead and your hands are raw, but the lamp never stopped. At first light a schooner lies safe in the lee of the rock, and her crew are waving.

dark.title: The dark hour
dark.note: The bad ending. Undo leads back to the storm.
dark.text: Some time after three your grip fails and the lamp stands still. You never see the ship. In the morning there is timber on the rocks, and a letter to write to the Board.

thaw.title: The thaw
thaw.note: Last choice. Both endings are fine ones; only one is a victory.
thaw.text: Spring, and the supply boat is a dot on the horizon. The year is up. Your chest is packed, or could be in five minutes.

stay.title: Another year
stay.text: You wave the boat off from the gallery with the new contract in your pocket. There are gears to oil. It is the first of the month.

home.title: The boat home
home.text: The rock gets smaller behind you until it is only the white tower, and then only the light. Somebody else's light, now.
